Title: Enhancements to Azure Machine Learning Studio

Body.Content:
Azure Machine Learning Studio (ML Studio) now offers the following enhancements:
  •  Updated New Experiment Flow: At the bottom of the ML Studio window, if you click +NEW and then select EXPERIMENT, you are now presented with a gallery of sample experiments that will help get you started using ML Studio.
  • Streamlined Experiment Page: The EXPERIMENTS page in the ML Studio has been updated to present a list of experiments with the experiment preview appearing in the right pane.
  • New Visualization for Data Tables: The visualization for data tables has been redesigned to present a column view of the data.
Visit the Machine Learning Center today to find out more about how to create an experiment and visualize data using these new features.
